context: First decide the wide-table strategy: scale to fit, reduce columns, or declare the matrix routes unsupported for print. Then implement: hide tray, facet rail, site header and pagination; keep the caption line carrying constant columns; break-inside: avoid on rows; explicit light-theme reset; a policy for the cloned sticky header. Verify with a rendered page, not only a rule assertion.
description:
There is no @media print block or @page rule anywhere in the Explorer and no print test. rx-ux-01 suppresses the tray; this item defines what printing actually produces.

Known hazards from review: overflow:visible alone does not make min-w-max tables fit paper and does not defeat enclosing overflow-hidden wrappers (Home.tsx:534, Query.tsx:725); QueryHeatmap's cloned sticky header (QueryHeatmap.tsx:598) needs its own policy; and printing while the dark theme is active produces illegible or ink-heavy output without an explicit reset.

Note: the Explorer exports CSV and JSON (Query.tsx:700). It has no PDF export - an earlier revision claimed otherwise in error.
